project_type: pnpm monorepo with Turborepo: Vite+React PWA + Fastify TypeScript API + shared packages
build_system: pnpm workspaces with Turborepo for task orchestration; Vite for web app; tsc for API and packages
test_framework: Vitest for all packages (unit tests); playwright or similar for e2e (not in Milestone 0)
build_command: pnpm build (runs turbo build across all packages)
test_command: pnpm test (runs turbo test across all packages)
verification_instructions: After each feature: (1) pnpm install to update lockfile, (2) pnpm lint, (3) pnpm type-check, (4) pnpm test, (5) pnpm build, (6) manually verify web app at localhost:5173 and API at localhost:4000/health
snapshot_or_generated_files: None at this stage; future milestones may include generated API clients or Prisma schemas
environment_constraints: Windows development environment (PowerShell); use double quotes for paths with spaces; Git hooks via Husky must work on Windows; Docker Compose for MongoDB/Redis/MailHog
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits enforced via commitlint; pre-commit hooks run lint-staged (eslint, prettier); TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess; no console.log in production code; all user-facing strings in i18n files; design tokens as CSS variables
key_patterns: Emotional warmth in copy; absolute privacy (max 2 users); time-zone aware (Asia/Kolkata and Asia/Bangkok); dark-first design; English + Thai from day one; Zod schemas shared between client/server; injectable dependencies for testability
directory_structure: apps/ contains web (Vite+React PWA) and api (Fastify); packages/ contains shared (types/schemas/constants), content (seed data), game-engine (pure logic), config (ESLint/TS/Prettier presets); docs/ for features/, adr/, runbooks/; .github/workflows/ for CI
